source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: مرة، قطتنا مشمش طلعت من الشباك وضاعت.
sentences.en: Once, our cat Mishmish went out the window and got lost.

sentences.ar: دورنا عليها بكل الحارة بس ما لقيناها.
sentences.en: We looked for her all over the neighborhood but didn't find her.
The kids got very upset and cried.
We asked the neighbors if anyone had seen her.

sentences.ar: بعد يومين، سمعنا صوت مواء من عالسطح.
sentences.en: After two days, we heard a meowing sound from the roof.

sentences.ar: طلعنا لفوق ولقينا مشمش خايفة بالزاوية.
sentences.en: We went up and found Mishmish scared in the corner.
We brought her down, fed her, and gave her water.
Since that day, we close the window at night.

sentences.ar: مشمش صارت تقعد جنبنا وما بتحب تطلع.
sentences.en: Mishmish now stays next to us and doesn't like to go out.
